title: Coal - Classification
description: Coal classification tool based on volatile matter content. This tool provides comprehensive classification of coal types from Anthracite to Non-coking coals, including their characteristics, volatile matter ranges, and typical properties such as sulfur content, moisture content, fixed carbon content, density, bulk density, and ash content.

rows: Heat altered low volatile steam coals

components.content:
### Typical Coal Properties

#### Sulfur Content
- Anthracite Coal: 0.6 - 0.77 weight %
- Bituminous Coal: 0.7 - 4.0 weight %
- Lignite Coal: 0.4 weight %

#### Moisture Content
- Anthracite Coal: 2.8 - 16.3 weight %
- Bituminous Coal: 2.2 - 15.9 weight %
- Lignite Coal: 39 weight %

#### Fixed Carbon Content
- Anthracite Coal: 80.5 - 85.7 weight %
- Bituminous Coal: 44.9 - 78.2 weight %
- Lignite Coal: 31.4 weight %

#### Density
- Typical Range: 1100 - 1800 (kg/m³)

#### Bulk Density
- Anthracite Coal: 50 - 58 (lb/ft³), 800 - 929 (kg/m³)
- Bituminous Coal: 42 - 57 (lb/ft³), 673 - 913 (kg/m³)
- Lignite Coal: 40 - 54 (lb/ft³), 641 - 865 (kg/m³)

#### Ash Content
- Anthracite Coal: 9.7 - 20.2 weight %
- Bituminous Coal: 3.3 - 11.7 weight %
- Lignite Coal: 4.2 weight %
